acceptedMathematicalSteps: Actual root existence precedes use of the original radius in I1/I2 shear preservation; this is not a registry-radius existence argument.
The common left collar Xa..loopILeft is covered by the same natural/B26 comparison; the full finite-N loop covers the otherwise nonuniform B26/B34/preparation region.
Physical eta in [-1,1] preserves the interpolation sign and the nonnegative terminal heat argument. Strict physical frozen representatives satisfy abs(etaRep)<1.
Post-C12 positivity does not assert aNew>2; vsNew>2 is sufficient for the actual frozen radical identity.
Actual I1/I2 E patches have a>=2+3lambda/2, and disjoint U patches leave E unchanged. No smallness assumption on bs is needed there.
The original natural axis branch, rather than division by X at zero, supplies F0 and M0/X regularity.
Given the genuine whole M_X=U identity and actual branch constants, pulse and first repair equations provide all-order axial zero support and stream reconstruction.
At a physical representative F>0,a>0,vs>2 imply gabs>0,lambda0>0,c0<0 and then the frozen Bs/Ls radical and denominator conditions.
